evals.prompt: Run shift-left on BK-101, BK-102 and BK-103. They are in Backlog and none is in a sprint yet.
evals.expected_output: Loads shift-left-testing, opens the batch session pair, ranks the three Stories in a table with a risk score and waits for the user's OK before any per-Story work. Refines the acceptance criteria, drafts an ATP outline per Story and prepares the handoff to PO and Dev.

evals.prompt: Groom the backlog before sprint planning: clean up the acceptance criteria of the Stories in Shift-Left QA and tell me what the PO still has to answer.
evals.expected_output: Loads shift-left-testing, selects Stories only (other issue types are listed with a reason, never dropped silently), refines each one in its own subagent and writes the questions for the PO or Dev in the handoff.

evals.prompt: hagamos el shift-left de las historias BK-210 y BK-211 antes de que entren al sprint, necesito saber qué criterios de aceptación son ambiguos
evals.expected_output: Loads shift-left-testing from a Spanish prompt (skills load by meaning), runs Phase 0 and Phase 1, and replies in Spanish while every repo artifact stays in English.

evals.prompt: refiná los criterios de la historia BK-305 y armá el esquema del plan de pruebas (ATP) antes de planificar el sprint
evals.expected_output: Loads shift-left-testing for a single Story batch, drafts the ATP outline with names only and keeps the coverage estimate, and never advances the Story past ready_for_dev.

evals.prompt: Test the story BK-120. It is Ready For QA and in the current sprint, run the manual QA on it.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT load shift-left-testing: a Story in the sprint with entry status Ready For QA belongs to sprint-testing.

evals.prompt: Write the Playwright automation for the checkout test cases already documented in Xray.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT load shift-left-testing: automation code belongs to test-automation.
